observations: Bounded zero-byte, short and rewind reads agree between interpreted and compiled native Lean
Buffered /dev/full write initially succeeds; flush reports resourceExhausted errno 28, and repeated flush succeeds
Large and high-level binary /dev/full writes report errno 28; truncate reports invalidArgument errno 22
Procfs content remains readable despite zero-size file metadata
limitations: These are Linux native Lean oracles, not installed Lasm Wasm passes
Other device types, non-Linux semantics, races, pipes and large-file coverage remain incomplete
